questions.question: What happens to the total mechanical energy of an object in an isolated system as it falls?
In the example problem, why did the initial kinetic energy term become zero?
questions.expected_answer: Because the ball was dropped from rest, so its initial velocity was zero.

questions.question: If air resistance cannot be ignored, is mechanical energy still conserved?
questions.expected_answer: No, because air resistance is a non-conservative force that does negative work on the system.
